newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 10.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Navy destroys 40 Tamil Tiger rebel boats by bombarding guerrillas' northeastern Chalai Sea Tiger base.
Tamil rebels say no plans for peace talks with government.
Government considering replacing preferential voting system with electorate-based alternative.

Parliamentary Select Committee talks on resolving ethnic problem resume after two-month recess; to concentrate on remaining issue like nature of the state, unit of devolution, land, finance and powers to borrow foreign loans.
Government doctors to stage one-day strike today to protest against government's failure to resolve salary anomalies.
